snippet.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World – Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
The powerful puff is back! When a massive meteor suddenly crashes into the Forgotten Land, it's up to Kirby to uncover its mystery, gather fragments of stars, and seal away an impending evil. Explore brand-new Starry Stages that transform familiar locations, use all-new Mouthful Modes to reach new areas, and more. Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World launches on Nintendo Switch 2 August 28, 2025.

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Kirby and the Forgotten Land on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World by purchasing the upgrade pack.
